legs.note: Found by the browsing census — what a person says at a browser that the corpus had not written down, rehearsed on a real stage. Read as perceive, reaches nothing. The same class as 'click the download button' in the ledger. ROUND 1: the class no longer asserts an affordance. The fill verb reaches a row the reading called a field even when it did not mark it fillable, and the press verb reaches a named candidate — what matters is which ROW was reached, not the reading's confidence about it.
legs.say: check the box that says remember me

summary: A checkbox named by its label is a press.
